canonical_truth.rule: Generated projections are rebuilt from canonical CommonProject files and are never edited as catalogue truth.

selected_design.runtime: The interactive shell consumes one generated compact build-bound module containing discovery, action, review-date and one degraded-mode source-link fallback per project. Full provenance remains in the content-addressed canonical detail record and is exposed only for the selected project after generation-, bytes- and SHA-256-bound verification; canonical public project JSON remains independently addressable.
selected_design.no_javascript: A generated first recovery page of at most 24 entries remains in index.html exactly once, outside the bootstrap module dependency, and is removed only after successful interactive startup. It links complete DE/EN paginated indexes and canonical project pages.
selected_design.machine_readable: The manifest and every complete canonical project JSON remain public and independently addressable.
selected_design.privacy: No backend, account, telemetry, cookie or runtime write API is introduced.

redesign_trigger.rule: Architecture review is required after two consecutive representative runs breach any browser budget, or one deterministic static budget is exceeded. Catalogue entry count alone is not a trigger.

does_not_establish: that a backend or runtime API is justified
that one timing sample proves a speedup
permission to weaken no-JavaScript access or privacy
